description: This Java class defines enumerations and utility methods for handling interest rate chart period types within the Fineract project, including mapping integer and enum values to descriptive data objects.

classes.name: InterestRateChartEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to convert period types to EnumOptionData objects and list of such objects, based on PeriodFrequencyType enum values.

methods.name: periodType(Integer type)
methods.description: Converts an integer to an EnumOptionData representing the period type.

methods.name: periodType(PeriodFrequencyType type)
methods.description: Converts a PeriodFrequencyType enum to an EnumOptionData with descriptive label.

methods.name: periodType(PeriodFrequencyType[] periodTypes)
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects for an array of PeriodFrequencyType, excluding invalid types.
